Excellent! I found the issue. The logs show that the ingress controller is blocking the `configuration-snippet` annotation with the message: "Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)". 

The ticket mentions that the redirects use regex capture groups that require custom NGINX configuration. The ingress controller was upgraded over the weekend with `allow-snippet-annotations` set to `false`, which disables the `configuration-snippet` annotation that was likely being used for these complex redirects.

Let me search the documentation to confirm this behavior and understand the implications.
